name: Finding the Undiscovered: Moon base profile (Artemis III)
method: Whole Earth at 10 km; criteria scored 0-1 (met at 0.70), AHP weights illumination 0.467, water ice 0.277, terrain and mobility 0.160, regolith and soil 0.095; no vegetation, passable ground and ice-free land required; 50 km around 32 known analogs excluded; touching squares of the same tier grouped into sites of at most 50 km.
